{"text":"Hi {first_name},

This is {clinic_name}. It is time to book a check-up with us. Please pick a time by {due_by}.

Call us at {clinic_phone} and we will help you set it up. It only takes a few minutes.

We look forward to seeing you.

If you no longer want these reminders, you can stop them here: {opt_out_link}"}
